title: Dynamic eviction attenuator and regional quarantine stabilizer (hotfix)
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Fixes an over-aggressive regional quarantine eviction path: adds a decay-aware attenuation layer and a feature-flagged stabilizer to prevent mass evictions during transient cross-region failovers. Backported as hotfix.
description:
Summary: This hotfix addresses a regression observed during a multi-region failover drill where the quarantine controller's instantaneous eviction score could spike and trigger bulk node/slot evictions in the affected region. The root cause was a mismatch between the quarantine scoring window and the decay logic in the eviction policy: short-lived latency spikes were amplified instead of being attenuated, which cascaded into capacity loss and higher latencies for remaining requests. This PR introduces a 'dynamic eviction attenuator' that applies a time-decayed smoothing factor to quarantine scores and a region-level 'quarantine stabilizer' that enforces a soft cap on simultaneous evictions and provides a controlled retry/backoff for drain actions.

Motivation and impact: During the incident the platform lost 18% of serving capacity in the region, causing end-to-end latency SLO breaches for several high-throughput tenants. The change is intended to: 1) prevent mass evictions from transient spikes, 2) preserve KV cache locality where possible, and 3) allow the existing circuit breaker and SLO enforcer to take corrective action without compounding failures. This is a targeted hotfix with a feature flag (runtime.feature.degradation.stabilizer) to allow phased rollout and measured rollback if needed.

What I changed (high level):
- Add attenuation layer (src/runtime/eviction/attenuator.rs) that smooths quarantine scores using exponential decay based on per-tenant and per-slot metrics.
- Add regional stabilizer (src/infra/region_quarantine/controller.go) implementing a soft-concurrency cap for evictions and a jittered exponential backoff for drains.
- Wire feature flag gating and metrics (pkg/config/featureflags.go, observability/metrics/eviction_metrics.prom).
- Add unit and integration tests that simulate transient spikes and assert no more than N concurrent evictions per region (tests/eviction/attenuator_test.go, tests/region_quarantine/flow_integration_test.go).
- Update rollout notes and a short mitigation playbook (docs/runbooks/region_quarantine.md).

Commits (summary):
- commit 1: initial attenuator implementation + unit tests (attenuator.rs, attenuator_test.go)
- commit 2: region stabilizer + controller wiring + feature flag checks (controller.go, featureflags.go)
- commit 3: add metrics, dashboards, and alerts adjustments (eviction_metrics.prom, dashboards/eviction.json)
- commit 4: test hardening and race-condition fix after reviewer feedback (tests/..., controller.go small fix)

Files changed (high level snippets):
- src/runtime/eviction/attenuator.rs: new file, core function compute_attenuated_score(score, age_ms, decay_half_life_ms) with comments describing expected behavior and complexity O(1).
- src/infra/region_quarantine/controller.go: introduces stabilizer struct with fields {maxConcurrentEvictions, backoffBaseMs} and a small state machine to track in-flight drains.
- pkg/config/featureflags.go: adds runtime.feature.degradation.stabilizer flag (default false for canary).
- observability/metrics/eviction_metrics.prom: adds eviction_in_flight_count and eviction_attenuation_ratio metrics.
- tests/region_quarantine/flow_integration_test.go: simulates 10s spike and asserts < 3 concurrent evictions and no capacity loss >5%.
- docs/runbooks/region_quarantine.md: runbook entry with playbook steps to toggle feature flag and manual rollback.

Checklist (internal):
- [x] Reproduced issue with unit/integration tests
- [x] Added attenuator + stabilizer implementation
- [x] Added metrics and dashboards for observability
- [x] Feature-flagged rollout path documented
- [x] Coordinator + SRE runbook updated
- [x] Post-merge canary plan (10% traffic in eu-west-1 for 30m)

Review conversation (condensed):
- Ravi Kumar: "High level LGTM. Two asks: (1) add clearer comments around the decay half-life choice and how it maps to observed spike durations, (2) ensure backoff doesn't starve the SLA for queued requests."
- Aisha (author): "Addressed both: added math comments in attenuator.rs and added a peripheral queue budget used by stabilizer so evictions don't starve queued requests (see controller.go lines ~180-220)."
- Elena Morales: "Can you add an e2e shot with a longer tail (60s) to validate we don't slowly bleed capacity?"
- Aisha: "Added extended e2e in flow_integration_test.go and tuned backoffBaseMs to 2000ms for better recovery."
- Samir Gupta (SRE): "CI flaked on one race in tests; after the test hardening commit, re-ran CI and all green. Approving for hotfix backport to release/2026-02."

CI and checks:
- build: pass
- unit-tests: pass (attenuator tests added)
- integration-tests: pass (regional flow tests)
- e2e: pass (short + extended scenarios)
- lint: pass (small gofmt/fix in controller.go)
- canary-smoke (post-merge): pending (run by ops after merge)

Risk and mitigation: This changes eviction behavior and could mask pathological load if coupled with other policy changes; mitigation includes the feature flag for gradual rollout, additional metrics to detect attenuator miscalibration (eviction_attenuation_ratio > 0.9) and an immediate rollback path (toggle runtime.feature.degradation.stabilizer=false) plus runbook steps to manually trigger regional circuit-breaker if needed.

Merge outcome: Squash-merged after approvals from Ravi, Elena, and Samir. Backported to release/2026-02 as hotfix/attenuator-regional-quarantine-stabilizer-backport. Post-merge ops plan: 1) enable on 10% EU-WEST-1 traffic for 30 minutes, monitor eviction_in_flight_count and p95 latency, 2) ramp to 50% for 1 hour, 3) full enable if no regressions.

Notes for follow-up: Evaluate different decay_half_life_ms per-tenant profiles (ENG-8910) and consider exposing a per-tenant override via Dedicated config in a future PR. Logs/metrics from the canary are collected under infra/canary/82463/ and will be used to tune defaults.
